name: NeRF-LiDAR
definition: A LiDAR simulation method that leverages real-world information (images and sparse LiDAR) to generate realistic LiDAR point clouds and semantic labels using an implicit neural radiance field representation.
summary: NeRF-LiDAR generates realistic LiDAR point clouds and semantic labels using multi-view images and sparse LiDAR data, avoiding the need for dense scans or manual 3D world construction.
